Uma obra traduzida estudada no curso

Duas obras do mesmo capítulo do livro didático

questions.hint: Uma boa comparação precisa de material dos dois lados.

Parágrafos por aspecto, com as duas obras em cada um

questions.q: Escolha uma pergunta de tema (ex.: "Como duas obras tratam o silêncio diante da injustiça?"). Indique quais duas obras estudadas você usaria e justifique a escolha em 3 a 5 frases.

questions.hint: Cada tópico deve mencionar as duas obras e um recurso literário.

tok.topic: TOK essay: final polish and academic integrity

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: What is the maximum word count for the TOK essay?
questions.hint: It is shorter than the Extended Essay.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: The TOK essay must respond to:
options: One of the six prescribed titles for the session
A title chosen by the teacher
questions.answer: One of the six prescribed titles for the session
questions.hint: The IB publishes the titles for each exam session.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: What should happen to the prescribed title in the essay?
options: It must be used exactly as given
It can be combined with another title
questions.answer: It must be used exactly as given
questions.hint: Changing the wording can mean you no longer answer the actual question.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: Which document records the interactions between student and teacher about the TOK essay?
options: The TOK essay planning and progress form
questions.answer: The TOK essay planning and progress form
questions.hint: Its name describes planning and tracking progress.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: How is the TOK essay assessed?
questions.hint: Compare with the TOK exhibition.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: Which of these is an example of academic misconduct?
options: Presenting someone else's idea as your own
Discussing your essay with your teacher
questions.answer: Presenting someone else's idea as your own
questions.hint: Think about honesty in authorship.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: When must you cite a source in your essay?
options: For quotations and for paraphrased ideas or data
questions.answer: For quotations and for paraphrased ideas or data
questions.hint: An idea can belong to someone even if you change the words.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: Which referencing style does the IB require?
questions.hint: Consistency matters more than which style.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: During proofreading, which question is most useful?
options: Is every paragraph linked back to the prescribed title?
Did I use as many long words as possible?
Is the essay over the word limit?
questions.answer: Is every paragraph linked back to the prescribed title?
questions.hint: The examiner looks for a sustained focus on the question.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: What does an examiner do with words beyond the 1,600-word limit?
questions.hint: Anything after the limit cannot earn credit.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: Which is the best way to strengthen a knowledge claim before submission?
options: Add a counterclaim and evaluate it
Repeat the claim in different words
Add a quotation without explaining it
questions.answer: Add a counterclaim and evaluate it
questions.hint: TOK rewards considering different perspectives.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: Which kind of example is most effective in a TOK essay?
options: A generic textbook example used by everyone
A specific, well-chosen example linked to the argument
A long personal story with no analysis
questions.answer: A specific, well-chosen example linked to the argument
questions.hint: Examples should do work in the argument.

questions.subject: tok
questions.q: What is the general term for taking someone else's words or ideas without acknowledgement? (one word)
questions.hint: It is one form of academic misconduct.

questions.subject: tok

questions.hint: "Counter" means against.

questions.subject: tok

questions.hint: Think about trust, sources and the reliability of knowledge.

questions.subject: tok

questions.hint: Consider argument, evidence and accuracy of language and citations.
